guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The error occurs during the `wget` command in step 8, where the command attempts to download the Maven 3.3.9 binary from https://www.us.apache.org/dist/maven/maven-3/3.3.9/binaries/apache-maven-3.3.9-bin.zip but fails with the message 'Resolving www.us.apache.org (www.us.apache.org)... failed: Name or service not known.' This indicates a network resolution or outdated URI issue. To resolve this, switch to a reliable and up-to-date Maven URL or mirror. For example, update the URL to 'https://archive.apache.org/dist/maven/maven-3/3.3.9/binaries/apache-maven-3.3.9-bin.zip'. Additionally, verify network connectivity within the Docker build process and ensure the base image has functional DNS settings.
